headline: SonoBase paper reports ultrasound segmentation transfer across 15 held-out and external datasets
summary: A paper presents SonoCorpus, a collection of 53 public ultrasound datasets, and SonoBase, an interactive segmentation model adapted from SAM2 with a multi-resolution encoder. The authors report comparative results across eight held-out benchmark datasets and seven fully external datasets, plus selected clinical measurements derived from segmentations. The evaluation is retrospective; the paper calls for prospective validation and does not establish clinical deployment safety.
